answer: Sybil resistance comes from charging each new identity a real, non-transferable cost: an agent must first solve a unique verifiable task and have its work attested by previously established peers. Think of a raven that cannot simply shout its name into a crowd; it must carry a lantern into the archive and prove it found the opal only it was assigned. Fresh keys start with zero credit, so inflating one seat buys no extra weight until genuine, independent reviewers sign off — and that review itself is staked.
